description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of `git cvsimport` with vendor branches in a CVS repository. It sets up a test repository, performs imports, and verifies the state of imported files to ensure correct handling of various import scenarios involving vendor branches.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository for the specified test case.

methods.name: git_cvsimport
methods.description: Performs the CVS import into a Git repository.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out the CVS repository at a specific branch into the working directory.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out the Git repository at a specific branch into the working directory.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares the contents of a branch's file against an expected file.
